source.model: ElevenLabs Sound Effects model selected by the service
source.commercialEntitlementScope: All forty-one source files and the ten edited runtime cues in this archive were generated under the user's paid ElevenLabs account.

assets.prompt: Seamless close exterior loop of a late-1980s vectored-thrust turbofan at stable idle on a carrier deck: deep compressor body, fine turbine whine, restrained intake hiss, no voices, birds, music or deck announcements, constant level, clean 8-second loop.

candidates.selectionReason: Strongest stable turbine character with useful headroom and no full-scale peak.

runtime.processing: Candidate 03; selected three-second stable cycle with a circular 250 ms equal-gain seam, centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM and 2 dB attenuation. The complete seven-second source remains archived.

assets.prompt: Seamless exterior loop of a compact military turbofan at high dry thrust, dense exhaust roar, intake rush and controlled turbine layer, no afterburner, no doppler pass, no clipping, no voices, steady 8-second loop suitable for pitch modulation.

candidates.selectionReason: Best balance of dense dry-thrust body, controlled turbine detail and peak headroom.

runtime.processing: Candidate 02; circular 150 ms equal-gain seam, centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM and 2 dB attenuation. The short 1.5-second source remains subject to in-game repetition listening approval.

assets.prompt: Seamless cockpit-adjacent airframe wind loop for fast low-altitude jet flight, broad turbulent rush with light panel vibration, no engine, rain, whistles, speech or impacts, neutral constant intensity, clean 8-second loop.

candidates.selectionReason: Broadest usable airflow texture with the least limiting and sufficient peak headroom.

runtime.processing: Candidate 03; selected three-second stable cycle with a circular 300 ms equal-gain seam, centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM and 4 dB attenuation. The complete eight-second source remains archived.

assets.prompt: Seamless vectored-thrust hover downwash loop above a steel carrier deck: powerful low jet wash, turbulent reflected roar and light deck rattle, no voices or alarms, no rhythmic pulsing, stable 8-second loop.

candidates.selectionReason: Most convincing sustained downwash and reflected deck body; attenuation restores safe mix headroom.

runtime.processing: Candidate 02; selected three-second stable cycle with a circular 300 ms equal-gain seam, centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM and 5 dB attenuation. The complete eight-second source remains archived.

assets.prompt: Short close mechanical sound of four vectored-thrust jet nozzles rotating together under engine load. Heavy hydraulic actuator movement, precise metal linkage, restrained mechanical lock and a brief natural change in exhaust resonance as the nozzle angle changes. Approximately 1.2 seconds with a clean editable tail. No speech, warning beep, explosion, landing gear, exaggerated machinery or cinematic bass hit.

candidates.selectionReason: Best combination of useful level and peak headroom without reaching digital full scale.

runtime.processing: Candidate 03; tempo-adjusted to retain the complete action in 1.2 seconds; centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM; 12 ms fade-in, 90 ms fade-out and 2 dB attenuation.

assets.prompt: Military combat jet landing gear extending and locking, heard from close exterior range. Smooth hydraulic actuator whine, solid undercarriage movement, restrained metal linkage and two distinct mechanical locking clunks. Approximately 1.6 seconds. Dry isolated recording. No engine, speech, warning tones, tyre impact, exaggerated metallic crash, music or ambience.

candidates.selectionReason: Cleanest opening, distinct mechanical action and a quiet editable tail.

runtime.processing: Candidate 02; trimmed to 1.18 seconds, centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM, short boundary fades and 4 dB attenuation.

assets.prompt: Compact military turbofan compressor stall under load. Abrupt deep engine cough, uneven exhaust surge, brief metallic flutter and decaying turbine instability. Forceful mechanical failure but not an explosion. Approximately 1.4 seconds. No speech, cockpit alarm, fire, impact, music or background ambience.

candidates.selectionReason: Best peak headroom, convincing initial surge and natural decay.

runtime.processing: Candidate 01; retained at 1.36 seconds, centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM, short boundary fades and 3 dB attenuation.

assets.prompt: Seamless damaged military turbofan loop with irregular compressor flutter, subtle bearing rasp and intermittent low exhaust surges. The engine should remain operational but clearly unhealthy. Stable overall volume, restrained enough to layer beneath the normal engine. Seven seconds with seamless beginning and end. No fire, explosion, warning tone, speech, music or external ambience.

candidates.note: Duplicate service download retained for provenance.

candidates.selectionReason: Best technical loop boundary and most controlled sustained level among the unique candidates.

runtime.processing: Candidate 02; selected four-second stable cycle with a circular 300 ms equal-gain seam, centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM and 7 dB attenuation. Complete source retained.

assets.prompt: Close exterior burst from twin 30 mm aircraft cannon pods. Five to seven heavy, rapid reports with mechanical action, compact pressure cracks and powerful low-mid body. Approximately 0.8 seconds. No shell impacts, ricochets, explosion, aircraft engine, speech, music or battlefield ambience.

candidates.selectionReason: Cleanest opening and tail for a compact five-to-seven-report gameplay burst.

runtime.processing: Candidate 04; isolated and tempo-adjusted to approximately 0.91 seconds, centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM, short boundary fades and 5 dB attenuation.

assets.prompt: Close exterior launch of a short-range air-to-air missile from an aircraft rail. Sharp ignition snap, immediate rocket-motor build, brief mounting vibration and rapidly receding motor hiss. Approximately 1.2 seconds. No explosion, missile impact, lock tone, aircraft engine, speech, music or cinematic bass hit.

candidates.selectionReason: Clearest isolated launch with usable space around the event.

runtime.processing: Candidate 01; isolated and tempo-adjusted to approximately 1.2 seconds, centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM, short boundary fades and 5 dB attenuation.
